MARGIN - writing assistant for Windows
======================================

Margin checks your writing in any app as you type: browsers, chat apps,
email and desktop apps. Mistakes are underlined on the text itself.
Everything runs on your PC; nothing you type is sent anywhere.


GETTING STARTED
---------------
1. Run Margin.exe. There is nothing to install.
2. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", click "More info", then
   "Run anyway". (The app isn't code-signed.)
3. Margin starts in the notification area: the blue "M" icon near the
   clock. Right-click it for Settings, Pause and Quit.
4. On first run, Margin downloads its writing model in the background:
   about 2.4 GB with a 6 GB+ graphics card, 1.1 GB otherwise. Grammar
   underlines work right away; AI suggestions start once the download ends.


USING IT
--------
- Type anywhere. Mistakes get a red underline (blue for clarity tips).
- Hover an underlined word and click the fix (or press Tab).
- Grey text after the cursor is a prediction: press Tab to type it.
- Ctrl+Shift+Space shows the full list for the paragraph you're writing:
  every fix, an improved version and rephrasings. Choose a style with the
  buttons on top (Standard, Formal, Corporate, Simple, Creative, Academic)
  or with Alt+Left / Alt+Right.
- Esc dismisses a suggestion. Ctrl+Z in your app undoes an accepted one.


PRIVACY
-------
- Margin never reads password fields and never saves what you type.
- No telemetry. The writing model runs on this PC.
- Exclude apps or websites in Settings.


REQUIREMENTS
------------
Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), about 3 GB of free disk space and 8 GB of RAM.
A graphics card with 6 GB or more makes suggestions about twice as fast.


UNINSTALL
---------
Quit Margin from its tray icon, delete Margin.exe, and delete these folders:
  %LOCALAPPDATA%\Margin   (writing model and runtime)
  %APPDATA%\Margin        (settings)
